subject: Budget display still wrong — Go handler returns hardcoded 20/20, state.db has 50/50

body.summary: The compositor now accepts trust_budget (T2 fix), but the values displayed remain wrong. Your Go status handler returns hardcoded trust_budget: {budget_current: 20, budget_max: 20} instead of querying state.db.
body.suggested_fix: In your Go status handler, replace the hardcoded trust_budget object with a query: sqlite3 $DB_PATH 'SELECT budget_current, budget_max, shadow_mode, last_audit, min_action_interval FROM autonomy_budget WHERE agent_id = ?'. Psychology-agent and psq-agent already do this correctly — their handlers can serve as reference.
body.field_name_note: The compositor accepts both 'autonomy_budget' and 'trust_budget' as field names. Either works. The shared vocabulary canonical name remains sqm:AutonomyBudget.
body.verification: After fix: curl https://<your-domain>/api/status | jq .trust_budget should show budget_current: 50, budget_max: 50
